hero_background.description: Abstract 3D geometric shapes for landing page background or hero section

marketplace_items.description: 3D printer actively working, use as category cover or featured marketplace item
Floating cubes geometric, use for a 3D model product thumbnail
Black and blue abstract structure, use for 3D printed object thumbnail

pages_and_flows.landing: Hero section with abstract 3D image, large Chivo heading. Explains 'Design. Print. Sell.' Three-column features section.
pages_and_flows.browse_marketplace: Bento grid of cards showing 3D objects. Each card has image, title, price, seller avatar, and 'Share Design' badge if applicable.
pages_and_flows.product_detail: Left side: large image/3D viewer. Right side: Title, price, Add to Cart (Stripe), Seller info, 'Download Design Files' button if shared.
pages_and_flows.editor_workshop: 3-pane layout: Left panel (primitive shapes), Middle (3D Canvas with grid helper), Right (Properties: XYZ, Scale, Color). Top bar for Save/Export.
pages_and_flows.seller_dashboard: Table view of listings. Columns: Item Name, Price, Sales, Status. Top right: 'Create Listing' CTA.
pages_and_flows.create_listing: Form to upload STL/Images. Inputs for Name, Price, Description. Toggle switch: 'Share Design Files with Community'. Small text: '3.5% commission will be taken on sale'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard tailwind light/dark mode (dark: classes) relying on CSS variables mapped to the colors provided.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei for the 3D editor and product preview components.
Ensure the Editor UI overrides generic styles to feel like a CAD/Control room (use Space Mono for coordinate inputs).
For typography, import Chivo, Work Sans, and Space Mono from Google Fonts.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for Landing/Marketing sections, and Shadcn UI (Buttons, Inputs, Cards, Tables, Switches) for Dashboard/Editor.
